name: Gerenzo's Orders
summary: At the Venture Company dig site in Stonetalon, Piznik works against his new boss, Gerenzo. The ousted goblin hopes to expose the ore operation by digging a sample while an ally guards him from camp patrols.

sections.title: Corporate Betrayal in the Crag
sections.body: At Windshear Crag, the Venture Company rewards ruthlessness over loyalty. Piznik once served as second-in-command at the excavation, until Gerenzo seized power, fired supervisor Ziz Fizziks, and sent Piznik back to the mines with a pick. Piznik did not leave. Under Ziz's instructions, he stayed on as an informant, watching Gerenzo's every move and waiting for a chance to strike back at the supervisor who displaced him.

sections.title: Unearthing the Gold-Green Vein
sections.body: Gerenzo's takeover springs from an obsession with a strange gold-green ore in the Stonetalon rock. He believes the mineral is worth an extraordinary sum, and has ordered miners to tear it from the earth in huge quantities. Ziz Fizziks has a mysterious new employer who may pay well for news of the venture. Piznik risks discovery to dig out a sample, relying on an ally to hold off aggressive diggers, vermin, and overseers policing the operation.

faq.answer: Piznik is a goblin laborer at the Windshear Crag operation in the Stonetalon Mountains. He once ranked second under Ziz Fizziks, but Gerenzo seized control and demoted him to mine labor.

faq.q: Why is Piznik mining this ore secretly?
faq.answer: Piznik is secretly gathering a sample of the strange gold-green ore Gerenzo ordered mined in huge quantities. His former boss, Ziz Fizziks, says a new employer will pay well for information about Gerenzo's valuable operation.

Gerenzo is the ruthless Venture Company supervisor who took control of the Stonetalon excavation by firing Ziz Fizziks. He turned company resources toward digging up unfamiliar gold-green ore found throughout the crag.

faq.q: Who does Ziz Fizziks work for now?
faq.answer: Gerenzo fired Ziz Fizziks, who then allied with new backers interested in monitoring Venture Company activity in the region. Ziz pays operatives and informants like Piznik to sabotage Gerenzo and learn what the company is unearthing.

faq.q: What attacks Piznik while he digs?
faq.answer: Venture Company workers attack Piznik as he digs, including Windshear Tunnel Rats, Windshear Vermin, diggers, geomancers, stonecutters, and overseers.

faq.q: What happens once the sample is mined?
aliases: what to do with the sample
faq.answer: After Piznik extracts the ore sample, he gives it to his protector to deliver directly to Ziz Fizziks. He hopes the sample will give Ziz leverage to thwart Gerenzo's plans.

angles.text: The strange gold-green ore found by Venture Company miners in Stonetalon matches neither iron nor tin veins, drawing the interest of prospectors curious about rare minerals.
The Venture Company's reckless, invasive mining despoils Stonetalon's natural landscape. Monitoring, disrupting, or exploiting the company's operations can aid Horde forces nearby.
